analyst.summary: Styrenix (formerly INEOS Styrolution India) makes engineering thermoplastics (ABS/SAN resins, polystyrene) for auto, appliance and electronics markets, with decent but not exceptional returns on capital and margins that swing with global styrene-feedstock spreads. Promoter holding has fallen sharply over three years, coinciding with the company's rebranding away from its former INEOS-linked name, and there is a flag around possible interest-cost capitalization worth monitoring. We rate this a Hold.
